svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Troubleshooting: dropped TCP/8080

g.text: Baseline: ICMP to 10.39.2.10 succeeds through r1. Reachability looks fine — now test the HTTP service.
Fault: curl times out. The SYN arrives on r1 eth1 but never leaves eth2 — a FORWARD rule drops TCP/8080.
Distinguishing evidence: ping still passes, tcpdump sees ingress SYN only, and the iptables rule counter
Smallest repair on r1: iptables -D FORWARD -i eth1 -o eth2 -p tcp --dport 8080 -j DROP. No broad flush.
Verified: SYN/ACK returns, GET / answers 200 with body packet-path-labs. Check DNS, direct and named
